params.body:
Closes #24

Switches cides.be from the warm cream/beige palette to "white + powder blue" (designer's handoff of 2026-11-21): a white page, light blue cards, a dark blue footer, the red #ED1D29 unchanged.

## What changes

- **Tokens** (`web/src/styles/global.css`): every value from the handoff table. New token `--sketch` (#F2F6F9) for the ground behind sketches and line drawings; frames with ground "card" now use it. `--cream` is renamed `--page` (it is white now), everywhere it was used.
- **Hard-coded colours**: the confidential veil and the Home hero overlay move to the new ink at the same opacities; the chip border and the line above "Result" on Our approach use `--chip-border`; the lightbox backdrop (written out because older browsers pass no custom properties to `::backdrop`) is the new footer colour. Contact has no hero overlay on the site, so only Home's changes.
- **Fixed images**: the four Our approach quadrants recoloured to #DAE6F0 and the Home disc to white, from the handoff originals (divide by the old background, multiply by the new one, so lines, shadows and CAD colours stay), re-encoded at the same size and weight as before.
- **Studio**: the ground options read "Sketch #F2F6F9", "Page #FFFFFF", "Dark #18212A". The stored values stay `card`/`cream`, so no document changes.
- **CLAUDE.md**: design rules 2 and 4 use the handoff's new text; the rules are in English now like the rest of the file. The repo has no `DESIGN-RULES.md` or token table in the README, so the token table lives only in `global.css`.

## Goes live together with the sketches in Sanity

Nine case sketches have the old beige baked in (carcube, dual decking manual, hipster, trailer4u, floor boxes, premium, snooker, slim LED, splitt). Merged alone, this PR would show them as beige blocks on the new ground. Their recoloured versions are ready, and a script uploads them and points the nine gallery references at them in one transaction (dry run on production: 9 documents, 9 references). The old assets stay, so it can be undone.

Order: pause the rebuild webhook, run the swap, merge this PR (one build), switch the webhook back on, then `npm run studio:deploy` so editors see the new ground labels (a merge does not carry the schema to cides.sanity.studio).

## Checked

- `npm test` 41/41, `astro check` 0 errors, build 88 pages, sitemap present.
- Home, About us, Cases, two cases with sketches, Our approach, Blog, an article and Contact at 1280 and 390 px with the recoloured sketches served in place: no horizontal overflow, no console errors.
- Confidential card (RheaVita) and Home hero with the new overlay colour, next to the live site.
- The red still misses 4.5:1 for small text (4.4 on white, 3.8 on a card), slightly better than before; design rule 3 keeps it untinted.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Switch the site to the white + powder blue palette
